claims.claim: Longformer combines sliding-window local attention and task-motivated global attention.
claims.verification_note: Global token choice is task-defined and distinct from padding mask.

claims.claim: Longformer also describes dilated sliding-window patterns and an encoder-decoder application (LED).
claims.verification_note: Separate encoder classification from generative LED.

claims.claim: BigBird combines local window, global and random attention mechanisms.
claims.verification_note: Explains block-sparse hardware implementations, not universal random sampling.

claims.claim: BigBird theoretical properties require the paper's sparse attention graph assumptions.
claims.verification_note: Do not generalize to arbitrary sparse masks.

claims.claim: When local/global/random degrees are bounded, sparse attention pair count scales linearly in length.
claims.verification_note: O(n(w+g+r)) is teaching edge-count expression, not measured latency.

claims.claim: Task global attention differs from padding and uses explicit attention masks in Longformer code.
claims.verification_note: Implementation-specific mask values must follow checkpoint/API.
